security: log-redaction-layer

Add an Events/Trace redaction layer so private keys and other high-entropy
values are hidden by default in the IDE's log surfaces.

- LogRedactor.tsx exposes redactText() plus <RedactedText>, <RedactionProvider>,
  and <RedactionToggle>. Built-in rules cover Stellar S/G/C/M identifiers,
  long hex blobs, base64 strings, and JWTs.
- Privacy-by-default: provider starts redacted, useRedaction() outside the
  provider fails closed, and the visibilitychange:hidden event auto-re-redacts.
- Unredact requires confirmation through a dialog warning about screenshots
  and recordings.
- EventsPane wraps every sensitive field (data, id, contractId, txHash) and
  exposes the toggle in its header.
- Terminal/TerminalPane mirror the global redaction mode into the terminal
  store; writeToTerminal() runs payloads through redactText() before they
  reach xterm so canvas-rendered output is also covered.

feat: extension Soroban tooling — linter, snippets, latency monitor, health alerts

Adds four cohesive developer-experience features to the VS Code extension:

- src/monitors/LatencyMonitor.ts: self-contained status-bar latency monitor
  for the configured Stellar RPC node. Polls /getHealth, surfaces healthy /
  degraded / unhealthy state with green/yellow/red indicators, and exposes a
  small event API so other services can subscribe to samples.
- src/services/HealthAlerts.ts: subscribes to LatencyMonitor and raises VS Code
  warning notifications when the RPC node experiences a latency spike or N
  consecutive failures (downtime). Thresholds, debounce, and on/off are all
  configurable. Quick actions on each notification jump to switch network /
  show health / disable alerts.
- src/services/LinterService.ts: background diagnostic provider for Rust
  files. Detects 15+ Soroban-specific anti-patterns (no_std violations, std
  collections, panic!/unwrap, mutable statics, std::time, RNG, missing TTL
  bumps, unsafe, etc.) and registers a CodeActionProvider with quick-fixes
  for the rules where a deterministic replacement is safe.
- snippets/soroban-snippets.json: 60 curated snippets covering the most
  common Soroban patterns (boilerplate, storage tiers, auth, tokens, events,
  cross-contract calls, tests, error handling). Each entry has integrated
  documentation explaining the pattern.

Wiring:
- extension.ts activates the linter on every load and the health alerts
  service whenever the latency monitor is available.
- networkStatusBar.ts now delegates the status-bar item to the new
  LatencyMonitor (single source of truth — replaces the older services
  variant which has been removed).
- package.json: adds onLanguage:rust activation, snippets contribution, and
  configuration for stellarSuite.latencyMonitor.*, stellarSuite.healthAlerts.*,
  and stellarSuite.linter.enabled.

perf: use web workers for non-blocking builds

perf: use web workers for non-blocking builds

Move the compile API fetch and stream reading off the main thread into a
dedicated Web Worker so the UI stays fully responsive during long builds.

public/workers/compile.worker.js
  Plain-JS worker served statically. Receives a `compile` message, calls
  the compile endpoint with fetch(), streams the response chunk-by-chunk
  back to the main thread via postMessage, and posts a final `done` or
  `error` message. Cancellation is handled through an AbortController
  keyed by job id; the worker responds to a `cancel` message.

src/lib/compilationWorker.ts
  TypeScript class (CompilationWorker) that manages the worker lifecycle:
  lazy spawn, typed message passing, cancellation forwarding, and automatic
  restart (up to 3 times) after a crash. Crashing rejects all in-flight
  jobs immediately.

src/hooks/useCompilationWorker.ts
  React hook that creates a CompilationWorker lazily on first use,
  terminates it on unmount, and exposes compile() / cancel(). Applies
  formatTerminalChunk to each chunk before forwarding to the caller.

src/features/ide/Index.tsx
  handleCompile now delegates the fetch + stream to workerCompile(). The
  main thread only handles diagnostics parsing and state updates, both of
  which are lightweight. Cancellation path (error.cancelled) resets the
  build state to idle without writing an audit failure log.
